label: .liveAngleCommits
find: if let draft = cropDraft(angle: degrees) { cropDraft = draft }

label: .liveAngleLeavesCatalog
find: guard degrees.isFinite, cropDraft != nil, let draft = shown ?? cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
replace: guard cropDraft != nil, let draft = shown ?? cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }

label: .liveDragCommits
find: if let draft = cropDraft(dragging: handle, dx: dx, dy: dy) { cropDraft = draft }
replace: _ = cropDraft(dragging: handle, dx: dx, dy: dy)

label: .liveDragFromShown
find: guard dx.isFinite, dy.isFinite, cropDraft != nil, let draft = shown ?? cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
replace: guard dx.isFinite, dy.isFinite, let draft = cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }

label: .liveAngleFromShown
find: guard degrees.isFinite, cropDraft != nil, let draft = shown ?? cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
replace: guard degrees.isFinite, let draft = cropDraft, let size = loupeItem?.pixelSize else { return nil }
